title: turn off eny mob
description: a gui that can turn off spawning eny mob if u do /mobgui:mobs
body:
This mod allows players to easily control which mobs can spawn in the world through a simple and intuitive GUI.

By using a command /mobgui:mobs , a menu will open showing a list of all available mobs. Players can click on any mob to toggle its spawning on or off.

When a mob is disabled, it will no longer spawn naturally
All existing mobs of that type will be instantly removed
Clicking again will re-enable the mob

This is perfect for:

Disabling annoying mobs like creepers
Reducing lag by limiting mob spawns
Customizing gameplay for your server or world

A simple and powerful way to control your Minecraft experience.
